environment.description: ECS Fargate task (platform version 1.4.0) with task definition parameter 'readonlyRootFilesystem: true' and NO tmpfs or volume mounts configured. The container's entire rootfs is mounted read-only by the Fargate runtime agent via overlayfs with upperdir on a read-only block device. No writable filesystem paths exist within the container namespace (verified via /proc/mounts showing all mounts as 'ro'). The heap is still writable in-process, but the exploit's code execution payload requires writing to /var/log/service/audit.log (fopen returns NULL) and more critically, the attacker's typical post-exploitation shellcode that drops a payload to disk or modifies /proc/self/mem mappings backed by file pages will fail. The Fargate platform enforces this at the mount namespace level before the container entrypoint executes - there is no runtime mechanism to remount.
